auth.notes: The owner's own Google Cloud project, a Desktop-app OAuth client and the Gmail API enabled. Publish the consent screen ('In production'): in 'Testing' Google expires the refresh token after 7 days. Several accounts: GMAIL_ACCOUNTS, one refresh token per mailbox (connectors/gmail/auth.py, run by the owner); an address that is only an alias inside another mailbox uses GMAIL_<NAME>_MAILBOX.
